# api


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

[`main`](https://alix559.github.io/nadayantra/main.html#main) keeps
every page and route it already had. This module only adds, beside them:

- `/api/...`: the same operations as JSON, built from
  [`main`](https://alix559.github.io/nadayantra/main.html#main)’s own
  functions
- `/app/`: the built frontend (`frontend/dist`), when it exists

and lets the frontend’s dev server (<http://localhost:3000>) call the
API from another origin.
